It is a strange thing - you get out and suddenly you lose the appetite to talk to most people, I laid on the couch staring into the ceiling for a few solid hours, I showed Bourbon my laundry (because, seriously, how are you going to get enough water to clean your clothes and garments up in the mountains? and yes, I have been up the mountains) and he said the overalls looked so filthy that he was physically sick, and this was a guy who was a frontier corps between *Pakistan* and *Afghanistan* All the people I want to talk to aren't around, abruptly you feel mellowed out and melancholic for the things that should have been, but can never be, I do not even really look forward to much except a hot shower and peace where you do nothing. Stranger still, reading books, I am not even playing any videogames - I am just reading, I reread The Seven Who Were Hanged by Andreyev, I might get my hands on a physical copy of The Idiot by Dostoevsky to pass the time in (no, good luck getting a phone in, if Security sees you will be sent to their branch in Nasr City and you will not have a good time, you might entertain them for five or six months as they go through all your contents) What to talk with and with who? a peculiar environment.
